data.title: Saylor Says There Is Always Room for More Orange. Strategy Bought 334 Bitcoin Last Week. Two Years Ago It Was Buying 55,000 in a Week.
data.description: Michael Saylor insists there is always room for more Bitcoin, but Strategy's latest weekly purchase raises a question worth asking: what does a near-microscopic acquisition reveal about the limits of the company's grand accumulation playbook?
